subject.title: WIP feat(cli): sync local schema artifacts on startup

question: Should OpenClaw ship default-on local editor schema sidecar support, and if so should it run only on OpenClaw-owned config writes rather than on every CLI startup?
rationale: The change adds user-visible config surface and default file writes, so the final default, opt-out shape, filename, and startup side-effect contract need maintainer product acceptance beyond code repair.

options.title: Use config-write-only sidecar
options.body: Adopt this feature only when OpenClaw is already committing config, preserving explicit `$schema` removal and include-backed roots; this likely means rebasing/narrowing the stronger sibling approach or equivalent code.

options.title: Sponsor startup maintenance
options.body: Keep the startup maintenance idea, but require a raw/root-preserving implementation with upgrade proof for include-backed and read-only command flows.

options.title: Decline automatic sidecars
options.body: Keep the existing manual `openclaw config schema` workflow and close the implementation PRs as product-direction rejected.

recommendation.title: Use config-write-only sidecar
recommendation.body: Adopt this feature only when OpenClaw is already committing config, preserving explicit `$schema` removal and include-backed roots; this likely means rebasing/narrowing the stronger sibling approach or equivalent code.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent config IO history and compatibility-seam work make this the best available routing candidate for the default-write and upgrade-safety decision.
